270412585_53f9c770.section: Connectivity and circuit function of vLGN GABAergic neurons

270412585_cdb4dcac.text: Activation of both the vLGN/IGL-projecting RGCs and the vLGN/IGL-to-LPBN projections is sufficient to reduce itch-related behaviors induced by various pruritogens.
